concepts.title: Multiplying and Dividing Decimals by Powers of Ten
concepts.definition: Scaling a decimal number by ten or its powers shifts the decimal point right for multiplication and left for division by the number of zeroes.
concepts.formula: scaled_result = decimal_num * power_of_ten or decimal_num / power_of_ten
concepts.key_idea: Shift the decimal point right when multiplying by 10, 100, 1000 and left when dividing.

concepts.title: Multiplication of a Decimal by a Whole Number
concepts.definition: The product of a decimal and an integer is computed by multiplying them as whole numbers and preserving the total decimal places in the final result.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply ignoring the decimal point, then place the decimal point so the product has the same decimal places.

concepts.title: Multiplication of Two Decimal Numbers
concepts.definition: To multiply two decimals, multiply the numbers as integers and set the product's decimal places equal to the sum of decimal places in both factors.
concepts.key_idea: The total decimal places in the product equal the sum of decimal places in the multiplier and multiplicand.

concepts.title: Magnitude Properties of Decimal Multiplication
concepts.definition: When factors are greater than 1, their product exceeds both; when factors lie between 0 and 1, their product is smaller than both.
concepts.key_idea: Product magnitude relative to factors depends on whether factors are greater than or less than 1.

concepts.title: Division of Whole Numbers with Decimal Quotient
concepts.definition: When dividing whole numbers with a remainder, continue long division into tenths and hundredths by inserting a decimal point in the quotient.
concepts.key_idea: Regroup remaining ones into tenths and hundredths to obtain a complete decimal quotient.

concepts.title: Division by a Decimal Divisor
concepts.definition: To divide by a decimal, transform the divisor into an integer by multiplying both dividend and divisor by a suitable power of 10.
concepts.key_idea: Scale both numbers by ten or its powers to eliminate decimals from the divisor.
